snippet.title: Arena Mayhem - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the arena. Join the mayhem. ⚔️
Arena Mayhem is a multiplayer melee action game where warriors clash in arenas filled with deadly traps. Choose your fighter, customize your weapons and armor, and battle friends or bots in chaotic close-quarter combat. 
🔥 Distinct warriors, weapons, and armor
⚔️ Free-for-all and team battles
💥 Dangerous procedurally generated arenas with deadly traps
🤝 Party up with friends or practice against bots
🎮 Cross-platform battles between PC and Android
Coming soon to Steam and Android. Wishlist Arena Mayhem on Steam and join the epic battles!
👉 Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5510730/Arena_Mayhem/
